statement: For N=n1+n2,d_i=2Ekin/(3m_i n_i),GaussianentropyofP_tau fi withsecondmoment<=3n_i(d_i+2tau/m_i) gives,forfixedR>0,A_R=H0-sum n_i logn_i+(3/2)sum n_i log[2pi e(d_i+2R/m_i)].
